title: 1808 Prairie loses its pitched roof and rises above Glessner
items: The Keith house at 1808 Prairie now has the flat top its 1888 photograph shows, with a stone parapet standing higher than Glessner's ridge next door. The slate hip, the dormer and the iron cresting are gone.
Its round bay on the south half now stops at the second storey under a moulded stone cap, where it used to climb under a copper cone.
The top storey runs straight across the whole front as a row of six tall windows.
